note: One row per relationship between a legal node and a record. A record can sit on several nodes with a different relevance and strength on each. Strength is assessed against that node's requirement only.

strengths.green: Strong: direct, authenticated, corroborated for this element
strengths.orange: Potentially relevant: authentication, corroboration or reading outstanding
strengths.red: Dubious: contested, contradicted or weakly sourced
strengths.brown: Remote: little realistic ability to establish this element
strengths.black: Improbable or irrelevant to this element
